CanteenIQ

Smart Canteen & Food Waste Management System

Presented by Ekyom Kaur · Class IX

Press → or Space to begin · F for full screen · N for speaker notes

A student project using simulated data. Not an official school system.

The problem

Cooking by guesswork

🍲 Too much

Unsold food, wasted money and effort.

😕 Too little

Items sell out. Students go without.

🕒 Long queues

Orders arrive all at once with no warning.

Question: can past data help a canteen prepare closer to what students actually want?
The idea

Record → Forecast → Plan

1

Record

Orders, prepared, sold and discarded portions.

2

Forecast

Three simple methods estimate tomorrow's demand.

3

Plan

Test preparation choices before cooking.

Runs in one HTML file. No internet, accounts or paid tools.

What-if simulator

Try a plan before cooking

Example: expected demand is 30 portions. How many do we prepare?

Prepared: 24

Surplus = max(0, prepared − demand). Shortage = max(0, demand − prepared).

Click to enlarge
Experiments

Testing fairly

Click to enlarge
  • A: compare methods with MAE and RMSE
  • B: exact, +10% and −10% preparation
  • C: baseline vs improved plan
MAE = average |forecast − actual|
Lower error is better on that dataset.
Simulated results. Not proof of real waste reduction.
Honest limits & next steps

What this project does not claim

Limits

  • All data is simulated
  • Small test set
  • Sign-in is demo only
  • Data stays in one browser

Next steps

  • With permission, record real anonymous counts for several weeks
  • Re-run the experiments on that data
Export / import · Click to enlarge
Recommendation

A sharper name and logo

PlateWise
Cook what's needed.
  • Plate = food and the canteen
  • Leaf = sustainability
  • Rising line = forecasting
  • Orange dot = the decision point
Why change? "CanteenIQ" is descriptive but generic. "PlateWise" is shorter, easier to say, and states the goal.

Other ideas: ThaliSense, ZeroScrap. I have not checked trademarks or domains for any of them.
